docs.title: Welcome to Miracle RO
docs.text:
Miracle is a Renewal Ragnarok Online server with high rates, a dedicated Quest Room, custom enchanters, World Boss and Hell Raid events, and daily activities that reward you for simply playing. This wiki explains every custom NPC and system on the server, with prices and item lists taken straight from the server's own scripts.

Server Base / Job EXP 1000x Drops 1000x (equipment 250x, cards 100x) Content up to Episode 20 Client 2026-01-07 Weekend bonus Double EXP and drops every Friday 00:00 to Monday 00:00

docs.title: Where to start
docs.text:
• New players

    Claim your freebies, get to the Quest Room and learn the main hubs.

  • Currencies & points

    Mission, Instance, Event, Card and Activity points: how to earn them and where to spend them.

  • Shops

    Quest Shop, Instance Point Merchant, World Boss Merchant, the Mall and more.

  • Enchants

    iRO Enchanter, Aulion, Desmond and the wing enchanters, with every possible result.

  • Content

    Hunting Missions, Daily Quests, World Boss, Hell Raid, Mining and the hourly events.

  • Official content

    80 official instances, the Eden Group, episode quests and official systems.

  • NPC directory

    Every custom NPC with its map and coordinates.

docs.title: The two hubs
docs.text:
Prontera is the main town. Around the fountain you will find the Kafra, Hera the healer, the VIP Admin, the Daily Quest Manager, the World Boss NPC, the Episode Skip NPC and the Quest Area NPC (prontera 149, 194) that warps you to the Quest Room.

The Quest Room (moc_para01) is where most custom NPCs live: the Quest Shop, the enchanters, the point merchants, the Card Trader, Hunting Missions and the gacha machines.

Finding an NPC

Every NPC page lists the map and coordinates. Type /navi <map> <x>/<y> in game to get a navigation arrow.

docs.title: Daily Quests
docs.text:
Location: prontera 154, 198

Register once a day and complete 5 quests, one after another. Each finished quest gives a random reward and a server announcement. Only one account per computer can register each day.

docs.title: Quest types
docs.text:
Each quest is a random type and a random difficulty:

Difficulty Hunting Collecting Instance Easy Kill 100 Bring 200 Clear any 5 instances Medium Kill 200 Bring 5 Clear any 5 instances Hard Kill 300 Bring 1 Clear any 5 instances
  • Hunting asks for one monster from the hunting list below.
  • Collecting asks for one item from the list for that difficulty. The items are taken when you submit.
  • Instance counts any instance you clear (party instances count for the whole party).

docs.title: Episode Skip
docs.text:
Location: prontera 164, 163

Completes the main story of an episode for you, including its key rewards. You must be a 3rd class or higher. Episodes have to be skipped in order from 18 onward.

New accounts get the 16, 17 and 18 tickets with the freebies.

docs.title: Automatic Events
docs.text:
Events start on their own every 30 minutes. When one opens, the server announces it and you have 1 minute to type @eventjoin and pick it. @eventjoin also shows your current Event Points.

Winners earn Event Points, spent at the Event Shop, the Mining Zone tool shop, Hell Raid and the Antiquity Gacha.

docs.title: The events
docs.text: Event How to win Prize Bombring Survive 5 rounds of exploding Bombrings, 30 seconds each, in quiz_02. 20 Event Points to every survivor Dice Stand in one of 4 boxes. A 4-sided die is thrown and the other boxes are kicked out. Last box standing wins. 20 Event Points Poring Catcher Dozens of Porings with fake names spawn. Kill the one named exactly Poring. Kill a wrong one and you are out. 20 Event Points Poring Hunter Score the most points before time runs out: Poring +1, Drops +5, Poporing -10. 20 Event Points Disguise The Disguise Event NPC in the Quest Room (moc_para01 31, 31) turns into a monster. Be the first to type its name in chat. 4 Event Points per round Monster Battle Two monsters fight in poring_w02. Bet 20 Event Points on one at the MVP Bet Girl. 100 Event Points if your monster wins

docs.title: Weekend double rates
docs.text: Every Friday 00:00 to Monday 00:00, Base EXP, Job EXP and drop rates (including cards) are doubled.

docs.title: Battle Rumble
docs.text: A GM-run event at the Novice Magic Tournament Gate (new_1-1). Only Base Level 99 Novices with an empty inventory may enter. You get random rental gear for 30 minutes, then fight to be the last one standing.

Paid with Activity Points. You earn 1 Activity Point per minute while you are actively playing. You get nothing while idle, standing in the same spot, vending or using a buying store, and only one character per computer earns points. Type @activity to hide or show the point messages.

You can play 10 times a day per account.

docs.title: Hell Raid
docs.text:
Location: prontera 113, 162

A 10-round party raid in ordeal_3-1.

docs.title: Schedule
docs.text: Registration opens every 3 hours (00:00, 03:00, 06:00, 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, 21:00) for 5 minutes. Talk to the Hell Raid Guardian to enter. You cannot join once the raid has started.

docs.title: How a round works
docs.text:
1. 70 monsters spawn around the arena.
  2. When all are dead, a round boss appears 10 seconds later.
  3. Killing the boss mails every player on the map the round reward.
  4. Talk to the Hell Raid Guide within 5 minutes and donate 10 Event Points together (each account can donate once per round) to start the next round. If nobody does, the raid ends.

The raid also ends after 1 hour or when everyone has left.

docs.title: Rules
docs.text:
• No Token Of Siegfried, commands or cash shop
  • No teleport, warp, branches or Ice Wall; nothing is lost on death
  • Bosses have extra HP and damage and only take 1% of your damage
  • One character per computer

A Novice-only mining area (job_thief1) full of Mining Stones. Hit the stones with a Pick Axe to dig up refine and enchant-grade materials.

docs.title: Entering
docs.text:
• You must be a Novice.
  • You may only carry mining tools, the materials you can mine, and Butterfly Wing #602. Anything else blocks entry.
  • All buffs, including food, are removed when you enter.

docs.title: Mining EXP and refining tools
docs.text:
Every hit on a stone gives 1 Mining EXP. Spend it at the Gatekeeper (Refine Mining Equipment) to refine your equipped tools up to +20, with no chance of failure. Refining to +N costs N × 1,000 Mining EXP (+1 costs 1,000, +20 costs 20,000).

Higher refines on your Pick Axe, armor, garment and shoes raise your chance of finding materials.

docs.title: World Boss
docs.text:
Location: prontera 136, 171

Every monster killed on the server adds 1 soul to a shared counter. When it reaches 75,000 souls, any player of Base Level 275 can summon the World Boss at the World Boss NPC.

  1. The boss appears on a random field map, guarded by 7 guardians. Each living guardian gives the boss one of its skills. Kill guardians to strip them away.
  2. The gate opens 5 minutes after the summon. Enter through the World Boss NPC (maximum 100 players, one character per computer).
  3. The boss leaves after 1 hour if it is not defeated.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
On top of the standard rAthena player commands, Miracle adds these:

Command What it does @eventjoin Shows your Event Points and lets you join the automatic event that is open right now. @instancepoints Shows how many Instance Points you earned today (daily cap 1,200) and your total. @activity Turns the Activity Points messages on or off. See Gacha Machines. @HourlyBan Opts this character out of Activity Points until you relog. @donate Opens the donation shops (PoD Shop and Cash Shop). @statsview Lists every active bonus on your character (HP/SP %, ATK/MATK %, damage modifiers and more). @dummy Warps you to the Dummy Punching Bags in Prontera. @pvpladder Opens the PvP/GvG ladder menu from anywhere. See PvP & WoE.

Commands are disabled in some places

Hell Raid, the Mining Zone and the World Boss map block most commands and the cash shop.

docs.title: Gepard Shield
docs.text:
Miracle runs Gepard Shield anti-cheat. Gepard identifies each computer, and several rewards are limited per computer rather than per account:

  • Freebies (once per computer)
  • Daily Quest registration (one per computer and IP per day)
  • Instance Points (one claim per computer per instance run)
  • Activity Points (one character per computer)

docs.title: One character per computer
docs.text:
These maps allow only one character per computer. A second one is warped back to Prontera:

  • The World Boss map
  • Hell Raid (ordeal_3-1) and the Battle Rumble arena
  • PvP rooms and the guild_vs arenas

docs.title: Captcha (macro checker)
docs.text: GMs can run a captcha check on any map. Everyone there gets an image with a 6-character code and must type it back within 60 seconds. You get 6 tries. Running out of time or tries bans the account, so answer it even if you are busy.

docs.title: 1. Claim your freebies
docs.text:
Talk to the Kafra Employee in Prontera (prontera 145, 197) and pick Claim Freebies. Each reward can be claimed once per account and once per computer.

FreebiesEquipment FreebiesLimit Break Shadows
  • A random poring costume (top) and a random costume garment, account bound
  • 1,000,000 Zeny
  • 7 days of VIP
  • 2× +9 Weapon Refine Ticket #6228, 5× +9 Armor Refine Ticket #6232
  • 3× Platinum Coin #30005, 100× Bronze Coin #30002
  • Episode skip tickets: Episode 16 Clear Ticket #1000282, Episode 17 Clear Ticket #1000287, Episode 18 Clear Ticket #1000288

Pick one job (Knight, Crusader, Hunter, Wizard, Sage, Blacksmith, Alchemist, Rogue or Monk) and receive a full starter set, all account bound: a +12 enchanted weapon, +11 enchanted armor, garment and shoes, and two enchanted accessories. You can only claim one job's set.

A +10 Limit Break Shadow Earring #1270127 and a +10 Limit Break Shadow Pendant #1270128.

docs.title: 2. Kafra services
docs.text:
The Prontera Kafra (prontera 145, 197) also offers:

Service What it does Save Position Saves you in Prontera. VIP Storage A second storage. Non-VIP players can still take items out, but not put them in. Reset Skill/Stats 5,000 Zeny for skills or stats, 9,000 Zeny for both. No limit. Platinum Skill Gives the quest skills of your job for free. Renter Gives you a cart, falcon, warg, Peco/Dragon or Mado depending on your job. Promotional Code Redeem promo codes from events and social media.

docs.title: 3. Heal and buff for free
docs.text:
Hera (prontera 153, 193) heals you to full and gives Increase AGI and Blessing for 5 minutes. You can also just type a chat message containing heal near her. VIP players get a much bigger package: status cures, AP, food buffs, Assumptio, Impositio, Suffragium, Sacrament and your class Spirit, lasting 30 minutes.

Every other town has a standard Healer NPC as well.

docs.title: 4. Go to the Quest Room
docs.text:
The Quest Area NPC (prontera 149, 194) warps you to moc_para01, where most custom NPCs are. Good first stops:

  • Paradise Merchant for starter weapons and armor, paid in Bronze Coin #30002
  • Hunting Missions to earn Mission Points and coins
  • Quest Shop to see what your coins can buy

docs.title: 5. Skip the episode quests
docs.text: If you are a 3rd class or higher, the Episode Skip NPC completes Episodes 16 to 20 for you with a skip ticket. The freebies include the tickets for 16, 17 and 18.

docs.title: 6. Test your damage
docs.text: The Dummy Punching Bags in south-east Prontera (around 220, 70) let you test your damage. Type @dummy to warp straight to them.

docs.title: VIP
docs.text: Buy VIP from the VIP Account NPC in Prontera (prontera 147, 174). It costs 500 Cash Points per day and you choose how many days. New accounts get 7 days free with the freebies.

docs.title: Benefits
docs.text:
As listed by the VIP NPC:

  • Character slots: 9 → 15
  • Storage: 300 → 600 slots, plus the VIP storage at the Kafra
  • +50% Base EXP, Job EXP and item drop rate
  • No gemstone requirements
  • Bigger and longer buffs from Hera and the Healers

docs.title: Daily VIP reward
docs.text:
While VIP is active, choose Claim Reward at the VIP NPC to get one random reward. You can claim again 18 hours later.

docs.title: Official Content
docs.text:
Besides its custom systems, Miracle runs a large part of the official Renewal content. This section covers what is switched on, read from the server's own script lists.

  • Instances

    All 80 official memorial dungeons, with entrance, level and cooldown.

  • Eden Group

    Eden Teleport Officers, starter gear and the level 100 to 140 mission boards.

  • Quests

    Episode quest lines from 13 to 20, Illusion dungeons and the level 200 dungeons.

  • Official systems

    Clans, item merge, mercenaries, marriage, the monster race and more.

docs.text:
These official parts are not loaded on Miracle:

  • The official job change quests. Change jobs at the Job Master instead (prontera 164, 195).
  • The official War of Emperium castles. See PvP & WoE for Miracle's own WoE.
  • The Izlude Arena, the God Item (Seals) quests and the airship routes.
